source: User photographs of Português a Valer 3 glossary, pages 202, 204, 206, 208 and 210
normalization_notes: Assistant visually transcribed the Portuguese and English columns. Other language columns and internal lesson-page numbers were not transcribed.
Original expressions, articles and capitalization are preserved in source rows. Vocabulary uses lowercase NFC word forms; article annotations are removed.

Expressions and reflexive clitics are split into individually translated components. Lexical compounds pré-fabricar are retained. Other inflected forms (e.g. raízes, fritos, recursos, humanos, inúmeros) remain distinct.
English source glosses are retained verbatim in extracted rows/source_senses; assistant corrections and component translations are distinguished from printed meanings.

Individual CEFR levels, Ukrainian translations, thematic groups and corrected/component English are assistant supplied, not independently reviewed. B1 is the user-supplied book level, not a level assigned mechanically to every entry.
Only thematic/grammatical groups are used. Provenance, pages and batch numbers remain metadata.
No database connection, conflict check or import is performed during preparation.
Fixed-expression components such as obstante and entanto have limited standalone use; preserve their source phrase context in source_senses.

enrichment_provenance.english: Printed English retained verbatim in rows/source_senses. Assistant corrections and individually translated components identified in metadata.
enrichment_provenance.groups: Assistant classification using existing thematic and grammatical topic names.

corrections.corrected_english: to become fixed; to settle; to be set at
corrections.note: Keep the pronominal construction as context and translate fixar and se separately.
Printed impact is context-dependent; standalone noun denotes disturbance/disorder.
Printed to regain is verbal; reconquista with article is a noun.
More precise standalone meaning than printed renewal.
Printed policy is contextual; broader dictionary-style meanings retained for individual-word practice.
Concessive expression; source English retained unchanged.

corrections.corrected_english: even if; even though; if only
corrections.note: Printed not even if is not a reliable universal gloss. Meaning depends on the sentence; retain source gloss separately.

uncertainties: Context-dependent expressions remain preserved in full. Only separately translated word components are prepared for import.
No live database duplicate/conflict check has run.
